examples.title: Common mistakes
examples.description: A config amtool accepts that still drops and mutes alerts
examples.config:
# Mistakes that amtool check-config lets through (the YAML is valid) or that are
# easy to make. Edit the config and the findings update as you type.
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
  slack_api_url_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/slack-url

route:
  receiver: default
  group_by: [alertname, '...']     # '...' already groups by every label
  group_wait: 10m                  # longer than group_interval
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  routes:
    - receiver: catch-all          # no matchers and no continue: nothing below is reached
    - matchers: [severity="critical"]
      receiver: pager              # not defined under receivers
    - matchers: ['service=~"auth(["']
      receiver: default            # the regex doesn't compile
    - matchers: [team="db"]
      receiver: db-slack
      mute_time_intervals: [weekends]   # not defined under time_intervals

receivers:
  - name: default
    slack_configs:
      - channel: "#alerts"
  - name: catch-all                # no integration: alerts sent here go nowhere
  - name: db-slack
    slack_configs:
      - channel: "#db"
  - name: old-oncall               # never used by a route
    webhook_configs:
      - url: http://oncall.example.org/hook

inhibit_rules:
  - source_matchers: [severity="critical"]
    target_matchers: [severity="warning"]
    # no equal: a critical alert anywhere mutes every warning everywhere

examples.title: Team routing
examples.description: Alertmanager's documentation example: teams, a continue fan-out, muting and inhibition
examples.config:
# A typical multi-team setup in the style of Alertmanager's documentation example:
# routing by service and severity, regex matchers, a fan-out with `continue`,
# out-of-hours muting, inhibition scoped with `equal`, secrets read from files and
# templates next to the config.
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
  smtp_smarthost: smtp.example.org:587
  smtp_from: alertmanager@example.org
  slack_api_url_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/slack-url
templates:
  - templates/*.tmpl
route:
  receiver: team-ops-mail
  group_by: [alertname, cluster, service]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 3h
  routes:
    - matchers: ['service =~ "foo1|foo2|baz"']
      receiver: team-x-mail
      routes:
        - matchers: [severity="critical"]
          receiver: team-x-pager
    - matchers: [service="files"]
      receiver: team-y-mail
      routes:
        - matchers: [severity="critical"]
          receiver: team-y-pager
    - matchers: [service="database"]
      receiver: team-db-pager
      group_by: [alertname, cluster, database]
      continue: true
    - matchers: [service="database", 'severity=~"warning|info"']
      receiver: team-db-slack
      mute_time_intervals: [out-of-hours]
time_intervals:
  - name: out-of-hours
    time_intervals:
      - weekdays: ["saturday", "sunday"]
      - times:
          - start_time: "00:00"
            end_time: "08:00"
inhibit_rules:
  - source_matchers: [severity="critical"]
    target_matchers: [severity="warning"]
    equal: [alertname, cluster, service]
receivers:
  - name: team-ops-mail
    email_configs: [{to: ops@example.org}]
  - name: team-x-mail
    email_configs: [{to: team-x@example.org}]
  - name: team-x-pager
    pagerduty_configs: [{routing_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/team-x}]
  - name: team-y-mail
    email_configs: [{to: team-y@example.org}]
  - name: team-y-pager
    pagerduty_configs: [{routing_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/team-y}]
  - name: team-db-pager
    pagerduty_configs: [{routing_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/team-db}]
  - name: team-db-slack
    slack_configs: [{channel: "#db-alerts"}]
examples.rules:
# Alerting rules for team-routing.yml: service and severity set by the rules, as the
# routes expect, plus a templated severity and a recording rule.
groups:
  - name: services
    rules:
      - record: service:request_errors:ratio_rate5m
        expr: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
      - alert: Foo1HighErrorRate
        expr: service:request_errors:ratio_rate5m{service="foo1"} > 0.05
        labels:
          service: foo1
          severity: warning
      - alert: BazDown
        expr: up{job="baz"} == 0
        labels:
          service: baz
          severity: critical
      - alert: FilesBackupFailed
        expr: files_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds < time() - 86400
        labels:
          service: files
          severity: '{{ if gt $value 172800.0 }}critical{{ else }}warning{{ end }}'
      - alert: DatabaseReplicationLag
        expr: pg_replication_lag_seconds > 300
        labels:
          service: database
          severity: warning
      - alert: DatabaseDown
        expr: pg_up == 0
        labels:
          service: database
          severity: critical

examples.title: kube-prometheus
examples.description: The kube-prometheus defaults: severity inhibition, InfoInhibitor and Watchdog
examples.config:
# Modeled on the kube-prometheus / kube-prometheus-stack defaults: severity inhibition
# scoped with `equal`, the target-only InfoInhibitor rule (an "always mute" idiom),
# a "null" blackhole receiver for Watchdog and InfoInhibitor, matchers written with
# spaces around the operator, and templates at a path that only exists inside the
# Alertmanager container.
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
route:
  receiver: default
  group_by: [namespace]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 12h
  routes:
    - matchers: ['alertname = "Watchdog"']
      receiver: "null"
    - matchers: ["alertname = InfoInhibitor"]
      receiver: "null"
    - matchers: ["severity = critical"]
      receiver: oncall
inhibit_rules:
  - source_matchers: ["severity = critical"]
    target_matchers: ["severity =~ warning|info"]
    equal: [namespace, alertname]
  - source_matchers: ["severity = warning"]
    target_matchers: ["severity = info"]
    equal: [namespace, alertname]
  - source_matchers: ["alertname = InfoInhibitor"]
    target_matchers: ["severity = info"]
    equal: [namespace]
  - target_matchers: ["alertname = InfoInhibitor"]
receivers:
  - name: default
    webhook_configs:
      - url: http://alert-gateway.monitoring.svc:8080/alerts
  - name: "null"
  - name: oncall
    pagerduty_configs:
      - routing_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/pagerduty-key
templates:
  - /etc/alertmanager/config/*.tmpl
examples.rules:
# Alerting rules in the shape kube-prometheus ships them: a PrometheusRule manifest,
# Watchdog and InfoInhibitor with severity "none", most alerts at warning, a few at
# critical and info, and labels such as namespace that come from the PromQL series.
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PrometheusRule
metadata:
  name: kube-prometheus-rules
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  groups:
    - name: general.rules
      rules:
        - alert: TargetDown
          expr: 100 * (count(up == 0) by (job, namespace) / count(up) by (job, namespace)) > 10
          for: 10m
          labels:
            severity: warning
        - alert: Watchdog
          expr: vector(1)
          labels:
            severity: none
        - alert: InfoInhibitor
          expr: ALERTS{severity="info"} == 1 unless on (namespace) ALERTS{alertname!="InfoInhibitor", severity=~"warning|critical", alertstate="firing"} == 1
          labels:
            severity: none
    - name: kubernetes-apps
      rules:
        - alert: KubePodCrashLooping
          expr: max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff"}[5m]) >= 1
          for: 15m
          labels:
            severity: warning
        - alert: KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch
          expr: kube_deployment_spec_replicas > kube_deployment_status_replicas_available
          for: 15m
          labels:
            severity: warning
        - alert: KubeQuotaAlmostFull
          expr: kube_resourcequota{type="used"} / kube_resourcequota{type="hard"} > 0.9
          for: 15m
          labels:
            severity: info
    - name: node-exporter
      rules:
        - record: instance:node_cpu_utilisation:rate5m
          expr: 1 - avg without (cpu) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))
        - alert: NodeFilesystemAlmostOutOfSpace
          expr: node_filesystem_avail_bytes / node_filesystem_size_bytes * 100 < 5
          for: 30m
          labels:
            severity: warning
        - alert: NodeFilesystemAlmostOutOfSpace
          expr: node_filesystem_avail_bytes / node_filesystem_size_bytes * 100 < 3
          for: 30m
          labels:
            severity: critical
    - name: alertmanager.rules
      rules:
        - alert: AlertmanagerFailedReload
          expr: max_over_time(alertmanager_config_last_reload_successful[5m]) == 0
          for: 10m
          labels:
            severity: critical

examples.title: AlertmanagerConfig resources
examples.description: prometheus-operator: a config Secret and two teams' AlertmanagerConfigs, merged the way the operator merges them
examples.config:
# prometheus-operator resources, as `kubectl kustomize` or `helm template` print them: the
# Alertmanager, its config Secret (the base config) and two teams' AlertmanagerConfigs, one
# v1alpha1 and one v1beta1. amlint merges them the way the operator does: each team's route
# goes first under the root, matches only alerts from its namespace and has continue: true,
# and every receiver and time interval name becomes <namespace>/<name>/<name>.
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: Alertmanager
metadata:
  name: main
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  replicas: 3
  alertmanagerConfigSelector:
    matchLabels:
      alertmanagerConfig: main
  alertmanagerConfigNamespaceSelector: {}
  alertmanagerConfigMatcherStrategy:
    type: OnNamespace
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: alertmanager-main
  namespace: monitoring
stringData:
  alertmanager.yaml: |-
    global:
      resolve_timeout: 5m
    route:
      receiver: default
      group_by: [namespace]
      routes:
        - matchers: ['alertname = "Watchdog"']
          receiver: "null"
    receivers:
      - name: default
        webhook_configs:
          - url: http://alert-gateway.monitoring.svc:8080/alerts
      - name: "null"
---
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: AlertmanagerConfig
metadata:
  name: payments
  namespace: team-a
  labels:
    alertmanagerConfig: main
spec:
  route:
    receiver: slack
    groupBy: [alertname]
    routes:
      - receiver: pager
        matchers:
          - name: severity
            value: critical
        muteTimeIntervals: [maintenance]
  receivers:
    - name: slack
      slackConfigs:
        - apiURL:
            name: slack-webhook
            key: url
          channel: "#payments"
    - name: pager
      pagerdutyConfigs:
        - routingKey:
            name: pagerduty
            key: routing-key
  muteTimeIntervals:
    - name: maintenance
      timeIntervals:
        - weekdays: [saturday]
          times:
            - startTime: "02:00"
              endTime: "04:00"
  inhibitRules:
    - sourceMatch:
        - name: severity
          value: critical
      targetMatch:
        - name: severity
          value: warning|info
          regex: true
      equal: [alertname]
---
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1beta1
kind: AlertmanagerConfig
metadata:
  name: search
  namespace: team-b
  labels:
    alertmanagerConfig: main
spec:
  route:
    receiver: webhook
    matchers:
      - name: service
        value: search-.*
        matchType: "=~"
  receivers:
    - name: webhook
      webhookConfigs:
        - urlSecret:
            name: search-webhook
            key: url
